product_metadata.title: Under Sink Organizer, DIFEN 2-Tier Sliding Cabinet Basket Organizer for Under Sink Storage in Kitchen Bathroom
features: Maximize Under-Sink Space: The 2-tier under sink storage is an effective solution for organizing the space under your cabinets. With this under sink organizer, you can make the most of limited sink space and solve under-cabinet storage troubles. The pull-out design allows for easy access to all your stored items.

User-Friendly: This pull-out under sink organizer can be used in either left or right-hand configurations, making it easy to work around plumbing and garbage disposals. The user-friendly design ensures that pipes are not in the way and the organizer provides enough room to keep everything in order.

Durable and Stable: Made of high-quality steel, this under sink organizer is sturdy and stable. The four suction cups help to fix the position of the organizer, ensuring it remains stable and secure. The slide-out shelf adds more cabinet space, making your kitchen and bathroom looks less sloppy and more tidy!

Perfect Size: Measuring 14.4"Lx10.6"Wx10.4"H, this under sink organizer fits great for most bathrooms and kitchens. The bottom area can hold bottles up to 6 inches high, making it ideal for storing cleaning products, toiletries and other items.

Satisfaction Guarantee: We are committed to providing good customer service and we offer a satisfaction guarantee with all our under sink organizers. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, we will help you return or refund it.
